title: Repost: a great horned owl staring you down

scenes.headline: Great horned owl, autumn in Connecticut

scenes.body: It can take birds and mammals larger than itself, but also eats scorpions, mice and frogs.

scenes.headline: Filmed by Paul Danese, Hockanum River trail, USA
scenes.body: Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

caption:
Those 'horns' are just feather tufts.

Agitated crows often gather to mob great horned owls, sometimes harassing them for hours.

Source: Cornell Lab of Ornithology.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Aggregator-repost demo: whole CC clip + credit + fact; the explicit credit card shows the format, the added fact is our value. Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
